title: Elasticsearch: CBOR parser in FasterXML jackson-dataformats-binary never invokes StreamReadConstraints (CVE-2026-68495)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the Elasticsearch package where the CBOR parser in the FasterXML jackson-dataformats-binary library fails to invoke StreamReadConstraints. This flaw affects versions prior to 9.2.8-r13 and can cause a denial of service condition. The issue has been assigned CVE-2026-68495 and is rated with a high severity score of 7.5. A fix is available in version 9.2.8-r13.
